hooks.text: Apollo 11 astronaut Neil Armstrong flubbed his most famous line.
Neil Armstrong never actually spoke his famous Moon quote correctly.
Over 500 million people heard Neil Armstrong's famous mistake.

title: The Missing Letter in Neil Armstrong's Moon Speech
description: Neil Armstrong's historic Moon landing quote accidentally changed meaning due to a single missing letter. Here is what really happened on Apollo 11.

beats.text: He planned to say, 'one small step for a man'.

beats.text: In the broadcast, he dropped the word 'a'.

beats.text: Without that word, 'man' meant all of humanity.

beats.text: After re-listening to recordings, Armstrong conceded he simply dropped it.
